name: Public web SDR receiver directory (KiwiSDR, WebSDR, OpenWebRX)
description: Snapshot of publicly listed, browser-accessible software-defined radio receivers with coordinates: KiwiSDR and OpenWebRX receivers registered on receiverbook.de plus a curated WebSDR/UberSDR/NovaSDR list. Each entry links to the receiver's own web UI, which streams audio directly from the receiver operator.
license_note: receiverbook.de (GPL-3.0 code; receivers are owner-registered, online-only snapshot). Curated WebSDR entries from rx.skywavelinux.com static_rx.js and priyom/dyatlov static_rx.js (GPLv3+). KiwiSDR.com's own directory is not scraped. Receivers are volunteer-run: honor each operator's user limits.
